$description: Wave 2 (D-013) component tokens for Link. Aliases semantic/* only. 'default' variant uses action.primary sparingly per D-001 accent scarcity — since Link is a common inline element, the 'subtle' variant (plain text color, underline only on hover/focus) is the one meant for most body-copy links, keeping the accent-colored variant reserved for the rare link that IS the primary action of a view.
